revision: H-v7 localized metadata-aware cumulative Yes/No repair (port of ngch D-v7)
extends: frozen_parent (B, or a C level over B)
locked: parent Yes (correct, accepted and resolved in the parent scoring) is immutable
targets: every other question; one sequential controller per capsule holding a target
bounded_search: off by default; explicit public integer domains only; reported separately
submission: ranked candidates are submitted one at a time to the sibling grader until Yes; a normalized value is submitted at most once per question
feedback_payload: per-question yes/no only; ideal answers never read in-process
yes_lock: every repair stage copies Yes results byte-for-byte; accepted answers are permanent
frozen_parent_outputs: localization, disagreement, bounded search and the candidate registry go to runs/<tag>/capsules/<slug>/, never into the frozen B workspace
worker_policy: one worker per capsule; heads within a capsule are sequential
